# SHA-384 of every migration, as sqlx records it in `_sqlx_migrations`.
# A migration that has been applied anywhere must never change, not even a
# comment: sqlx compares this checksum on every start and refuses to run
# against a database whose applied migration differs (#111).

# remove a line.
